title: Search - clean up case sensitivity option in term-based queries

timeline.message:
Change caseSensitive Boolean setting in term/prefix/wildcard/regexp queries to an enum.

Closes #63893
timeline.author: markharwood

timeline.body:
Case sensitivity options are an uncomfortable fit with a boolean setting - changing to enum.
Closes #63893

timeline.author: markharwood

timeline.body:
I am wondering why we organize `case_sensitivity` options as parseFields,  why not just strings?
as `field_default` and `insensitive` are not field names, but rather field values?

reply.body: Thanks, Mayya. I was just following the pattern from `collect_mode` in aggs which uses an enum. This all may be academic because we might be going with a simple boolean, pending discussion (addressed in alternative PR https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/63926 )
